creditCheckId.title: Credit Check Id
creditCheckId.description: Record Id of the Credit Check that was created and stored. Empty if the result could not be saved.

creditCheckReference.title: Credit Check Reference
creditCheckReference.description: The bureau enquiry reference for this pull, e.g. EQFX-CRI-20260816-194980. Quote this when referring to the enquiry.

creditScore.title: Credit Score
creditScore.description: Credit score returned by the bureau, on a 0-1200 scale. Empty when the bureau could not score the file or the enquiry failed — treat an empty score as unknown, never as zero.

loanApplicationId.title: Loan Application Id
loanApplicationId.description: The Loan Application this result belongs to. Returned so a batch of results can be matched back to what was asked for.

statusMessage.title: Status Message
statusMessage.description: Plain-language outcome of the enquiry, such as Clean file, Thin file adverse, or the reason it failed. Use this to explain the result rather than restating the raw score.

succeeded.title: Succeeded
succeeded.description: True when the bureau returned a usable credit file and it was stored. False when the enquiry failed or the record could not be saved; check Status Message for the reason before relying on the score.
